name: OnboardingForm
title: Templates/Platform/Account/OnboardingForm
summary: The /signup/onboarding screen, frame included: the signed-out `GlobalHeader` over a two-column grid whose left column is a `Card` with a flat `Progress`, the step counter and heading, the step’s fields and a Back / Continue row, and whose right column, from `lg` up, is a wireframe of the app the new organization will open into. The flow shows one step at a time; each story here is one of the three. Built from `Field` with `Input`, `RadioCards` under a `Label` with a `HelperText`, a `Field.Label` choice card around a `Switch`, `Tag`, `Avatar` and `Button`; picking a paid plan opens the upgrade `Drawer` with `ToggleGroup`, `Field` with `Input`, `Select` and `Checkbox`, `Link` and `Alert`.

variants.name: Plan
variants.summary: Step 2 of 3: the three plans as full-width rows; Free selects directly, while Pro or Enterprise opens the upgrade drawer and only selects once Upgrade is pressed.

variants.name: Profile
variants.summary: Step 3 of 3: the usage and role questions, the onboarding-session switch and the Create Organization action.
